style.styleTitle: Personalised Set of Gingerbread Family Christmas Decorations by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised family Christmas decoration set, made from mirror acrylic. Featuring up to 2 adult and 4 children gingerbreads, this decoration set is perfect for celebrating a family this Christmas. The adults measure approximately 5 x 5.5 cm, with the children measuring approximately 4 x 4.5 cm. The decorations come with a white satin hanging ribbon.
